content: आतञ्चनम् .²1 Causing to coagulate or curdle, casting butter-milk into heated milk to turn it. .²2 Causing to contract in general. .²3 Curdled milk. .²4 That which causes coagulation, a runnet. .²5 A sort of whey. .²6 Conveying. .²7 Gratifying, satisfying. .²8 Casting away, destroying. .²9 Danger, calamity. .²10 Speed, velocity. .²11 Calcining, adding flux to metals in fusion. .²12 The flux so used. .²13 Making fat; <ab>cf.</ab> आतञ्चनं प्रतीवापे जवनाप्यायनार्थयोः <ls>Nm.</ls>
